meta_description: Allyearround is your trusted painter and decorator across Birmingham. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full house renovation, we transform spaces with meticulous attention to detail and professional results.
services_subhead: We handle every interior and exterior painting project, from careful preparation through to the final coat — all finished to the highest standard.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Transform your rooms with expert interior painting. We prepare walls properly, choose the right finishes, and deliver clean, professional results that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior. We work in all weathers, prep surfaces thoroughly, and use quality exterior paints that resist the UK climate.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold feature walls. We help you choose the right colour, apply it flawlessly, and transform your space in a single project.

services.title: Wood & Trim Work
services.desc: Windows, doors, skirting boards, and woodwork demand precision. We sand, prime, and finish timber surfaces for a sharp, durable look.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Prep
services.desc: From wallpaper hanging to complex wall repairs and preparation, we ensure surfaces are flawless before any paint or paper goes on.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: We work with Birmingham businesses to refresh retail spaces, offices, and commercial properties on time and within budget, with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: Good painting isn't just about slapping paint on walls. It's about care, preparation, and getting the detail right.
about_para_1: Allyearround was founded on the principle that decorating should be straightforward, honest, and done properly. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time across Birmingham and the surrounding areas. We take pride in turning living spaces into homes our customers love to spend time in.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to preparation — we never cut corners on sanding, filling, and priming. That's why our customers recommend us to friends and neighbours, and why so many return for their next project. We listen to what you want, give you a fair price, and deliver a finish you'll be proud of.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs redecorated. Allyearround took time to prep everything properly, and the finish is immaculate. No mess, no fuss, great lads. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed my bedroom completely refreshed. They matched the colour perfectly, wallpapered one wall, and left everything spotless. Fair price and quick turnaround. Will use again.
reviews.author: Sandra L.

reviews.text: Exterior work on our Victorian terrace. They were professional, worked around the weather, and the paint's holding up brilliantly. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: David H.
